programme.title: Capítulo 153
programme.desc: José kisses Teo after revealing her feelings; though he's unconscious. Giovanni reveal he knows where all the records of the Lodge are kept; him, Miguel, and Diego try to retrieve them but get caught by the Lodge. Gandia finds out Pilar is apart of the Lodge but vows to protect her. Rodrigo sets the basement on fire, trapping the guys. Franco finds out Mia is in the band. Roberta and the others convince Gandia to rescue the guys.

programme.title: Capítulo 154
programme.desc: Roberta saves the Lodge files from burning; she gives them to Gandia. Gandia tells Mendiola the Lodge exists and is ordered to get rid of the evidence. Mia tells Miguel what Viviana did. Gandia and Mendiola plan to blame everything on Giovanni. Alma has decided to never bother Roberta again. Miguel confront Viviana about the letter; he breaks up with her. Teo and his father reconnect.

programme.title: Capítulo 155
programme.desc: Alma refuses to talk to Roberta. Giovanni is blamed for everything concerning with the Lodge and expelled; the other students demand justice and Roberta threatens to tell all. Gustavo and Marcia, decide it's better for Gustavo to have custody of Teo. Gandia punishes the students for protesting. Franco punishes Mia unjustly. Teo confronts José about saying she was his girlfriend. Rodrigo kidnaps Roberta for her interference; Diego ditches school to go find her.

programme.title: Capítulo 156
programme.desc: Rodrigo tries to attack Roberta but Diego saves her. León demands that all the Lodge members be taken to prison. Carlo finds Alma a performance opportunity in New York. José leaves the hospital after being found out by Teo.

programme.title: Capítulo 157
programme.desc: As vacation nears, Diego and Tomás forgive Giovanni and invite him to go with them.Giovanni's father tells him not to come home. Miguel is asked by Franco to keep watch over Mia during vacation. Mia, Vico, and Celina plan a vacation. Roberta, Lupita, and José plan a vacation. Mia tells Alma she's dating Gastón. Alma convinces Franco to let Mia stay in the band.

programme.title: Capítulo 158
programme.desc: The anonymous gossip column is all about Mia and Gastón. Teo and José are set up by Roberta and Lupita. Giovanni is given his own apartment. Gandia sees the gossip column and gives it to Franco, who flies into a rage. While Franco is threatening Gastón, Miguel jumps in and says he's dating Mia. José refuses to let her feelings for Teo show.

programme.title: Capítulo 159
programme.desc: Vacation planning continues for everyone; In the end, all twelve has Canada as their destination. Gastón is angry when Mia tells him that her and Miguel will be going to dinner with her dad. Madariaga tells Giovanni he'll help him get back into Elite Way School. Celina has lost weight. Valeria tells Franco Mia and Miguel's relationship is a lie; she secretly invites Viviana; Mia punches her.

programme.title: Capítulo 160
programme.desc: Mía reproaches Miguel for dating Viviana again. Gastón catches Mía and Miguel kissing and becomes furious. Valeria and Viviana come up with a plan to expose Mía and Miguel, but it backfires. The group enjoy Canada. Roberta, José, and Lupita run into Pilar. Alma decides to leave Mexico. Mayra, Lupita's aunt, speaks to Nico's mom.

programme.title: Capítulo 161
programme.desc: Mia and Diego, Miguel and Roberta, act as sweethearts to make each other jealous. Franco tries to persuade Alma not to leave Roberta by leaving the country; he lies to Valeria about it. The group is welcomed to the Banff Hotel. Teo surprises José with the help of Lupita and Roberta. Pilar keeps up her conniving ways. José refuses Teo's advances.

programme.title: Capítulo 162
programme.desc: Vico, Celina, and José plan to pair Mia with Miguel and Roberta with Diego. Teo insists that José be his girlfriend. Mayra tells Nico's mom she has three days to tell Nico the truth. Tomás asks Lupita to be a couple. León hires someone to look into Mabel's boyfriend. Renata tells Mendiola she wants Madariaga gone. Miguel's mother comes to the Colucci house; Carlo recognizes her.

programme.desc: Ismael sets to getting Rutila out of jail. Tony kills the Russians as a fake token to Victor. Victor releases Monica and her merch. Rivero and Garcia bait Teran but he turns the table and fires him. He appoints Castillo Head of Defense.

programme.title: Los Casillas frente a frente
programme.desc: Pilar finds trouble. Victor and Aurelio make peace. Victor cleans his business. Aurelio offers Victor work. Paloma goes to Cancun. Monica sets up a meeting with Castrata. Aurelio challenges Monica over her partner. Aurelio is out for blood.

programme.title: Cita sangrienta
programme.desc: Aurelio tells the family of Monica's dealings. Swears revenge to Carmen. Omar denies Rivero's request. Victor enjoys BabyGirl and peace. Tata receives bad news. Victor's meeting with Tony proves fatal. Skinny and BabyGirl narrowly escape.

programme.title: El plan inesperado
programme.desc: Salazar and Colon are on a stakeout in Haiti. Felina remembers the men in her life. Ruti calls out Sebas coke usage. Tony hires Filemon. BabyGirl kills Ruben. Rodrigo helps Garcia escape. Pilar meets the distributor in Europe.

programme.title: Infeliz encuentro
programme.desc: Castillo informs Teran of Evelyn's escape. Juan Carlos demands Tony. Arabs agree to deal with Pilar. Paloma asks Omar for a divorce. Zoe buys Esperanza a gift. Aurelio is transporting the shipment via Cartel of the Suns.

programme.title: Escandalo a la vista
programme.desc: The family arranges Victor's final resting. Pilar and Felina move on the emerald and cocaine businesses in Spain. Aurelio settles tempers on the left and right in Colombia. Carla is making waves on her radio show.

programme.title: El presidente un sicario
programme.desc: Filemon continues to fail Tony. Juan Carlos seeks out Ruth. Aurelio meets the President in Caracas. Monica relocates to the US and re-affirms her deal with 30-30. Felina showcases the emeralds to Spain. Ismael finds the Maras holed up.

programme.title: Caller a un testigo
programme.desc: Venezuelan President asks Aurelio for a favor. The Defense is preparing a raid. Paloma returns to Los Pinos. Tony wants to avenge Ruben. Grenas mentions the sighting of Esperanza. Aurelio wants Skinny in Honduras. The shipment gets stopped.

programme.title: Mas de una baja
programme.desc: Penumbra gets the shipment released. Omar blackmails Jaime. Pilar gets ahead of herself and Feline doesn't trust the distributor. Aurelio kills Jobless and escapes DEA. Colon sees Tata from drone photos and pinpoints the ranch.

programme.title: Rodean a los Casillas
programme.desc: Monica quarrels with BabyGirl but pays respect to see Isidro. Carmen's smitten for Ismael. Wig tracks Esperanza to Boulder. Buzzy gets free. The Army raids the ranch. Aurelio has a jet, a helicopter and a secret tunnel.

programme.title: El origen
programme.desc: Morris está en la etapa de las dudas y pregunta a sus padres cómo conquistar al amor de su vida. Alejandra y Rocko deciden contarle una historia de amor: el relato de cómo se conocieron.

programme.title: El wifi
programme.desc: Silvia instala internet de alta velocidad en su departamento, sin embargo su conexión es muy lenta; lo que no sabe es que sus vecinos saben la contraseña y todos se conectan a su red.

programme.title: El método
programme.desc: Lorena está cansada de que Frankie no consiga trabajo y a éste se le ocurre una gran idea: poner una academia de actuación basada en el Método Rivers.

programme.title: El click
programme.desc: Arturo llora porque su familia es pobre y Lorena lo consuela, Germán y Pedro creen que son amantes. Magda encuentra una nota de amor y las cosas se enredan más de la cuenta.

programme.title: La separación
programme.desc: Lorena trata de seducir a Frankie, pero él la rechaza porque está escribiendo un guión, ella lo insulta y él decide irse de su casa. Finalmente Benito regresa a casa después de 10 años.

programme.title: Benito regresa
programme.desc: Benito está de regreso después de mucho tiempo. Lalo invita a salir a Silvita y comienza a planear su futuro. A los López Pérez les cortan los servicios y dejan sin luz a media colonia.

programme.title: Los candidatos
programme.desc: Silvia y Arturo compiten para ser el presidente del vecindario. Alejandra y Rocko se preocupan porque creen que han perdido su juventud y personalidad.

programme.title: Hoy juega México
programme.desc: La tía Oli visita a su sobrina Silvita y no se irá hasta conseguirle pareja. Germán organiza una reunión para ver fútbol, pero todos escapan cuando les pide cooperación. Silvita intenta imitar a su tía, mientras en su casa se arma un caos.

programme.title: Reunión de ex alumnos
programme.desc: Silvia organiza una reunión en su departamento para sus excompañeros, por lo que le pide a Pedro que se haga pasar por su novio para que no piensen que sigue soltera.

programme.title: Jorjáis roomie
programme.desc: Magdalena sospecha de que Lorena tiene un amante y convence a Silvia de seguirla para descubrir la verdad. Pedro le renta a Jorjáis la habitación de Luis para que tenga donde dormir, sin imaginar las consecuencias.

programme.title: La telenovela
programme.desc: Los vecinos rentan el edificio para la grabación de una telenovela y por accidente, Jorjáis resulta ser un gran actor compartiendo escenas con Renata Notni.

programme.title: Mi vieja
programme.desc: Luis le pide a Pedro que lo releve con un asunto. Pedro se confunde y actúa de manera exagerada. Germán evitará que dejen basura afuera del edificio.

programme.title: Nuevo inquilino
programme.desc: Un nuevo vecino llega al edificio para rentar uno de los departamentos y Silvia se enamora de él. Germán quiere tatuarse y pide recomendaciones.

programme.title: La venganza de la maestra
programme.desc: Alejandra descubre que la maestra de Morris es Belén, la misma maestra que ella molestaba. Chelo, la empleada doméstica de Silvia, tiene más suerte en el amor que ella.

programme.title: Arturo amuleto
programme.desc: Jorjáis cree que Arturo le trae buena suerte a su equipo de fútbol cuando va a los partidos, por lo que buscará la manera para que él esté presente en la final del torneo y así poder ganar.

programme.title: La bomba de agua
programme.desc: Los vecinos le piden a Germán que repare la bomba de agua del edificio para evitar pagarle a un plomero profesional. Jovita intenta que Pedro cambie sus hábitos alimenticios, pero él se rehúsa y hace una huelga de hambre.

programme.title: Echando cohetes
programme.desc: Los vecinos se molestan por el ruido que provocan los cohetes de una fiesta. Rocko se queja de que Alejandra no es cariñosa con él.

programme.title: El desalojo
programme.desc: Frankie se entera de que un famoso director está interesado en uno de sus guiones. Los López Pérez reciben una orden de desalojo. Germán decide irse a Estados Unidos tras una decepción amorosa.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: The MeatEater Podcast - Theodore Roosevelt on Love, Ladies, and Conservation | The MeatEater Podcast Ep. 841 - 12 - 841
programme.desc: Steven Rinella talks with author of The Loves Of Theodore Roosevelt and CEO of the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library, Ed O'Keefe. Joined by Randall Williams, Phil Taylor, and Corinne Schneider. Topics discussed: The ladies in Teddy's life; being a sickly child and powering through pain; hunting to study; a tremendous taxidermy collection; a family that founded so many museums; sisters as advisors and confidants; a life-altering Valentine's Day tragedy; when a thick manuscript in your front jacket pocket stops a bullet and saves your life; being the first president to embrace women's suffrage and the right to own property; one of the most beloved in American history; and more. programme.title: MeatEater - Primal Cuts: Bone-in Cooking Special
programme.desc: In this cooking special, Steven Rinella shows his fans some of his favorite preparations for big, bone-in cuts of red meat. Interspersed with highlights from his recent caribou, buffalo, and mule deer hunts, the show features recipes that utilize some of the most underappreciated parts of big game animals. This episode is an attractive and delicious tribute to Steve's gun-to-table ethic.

programme.title: MeatEater - El Venado Blanco: Mexico Coues Deer
programme.desc: Steven Rinella returns to his favorite hunting grounds of Sonora, Mexico to hunt for a Coues deer buck during the peak rutting season. Steve sets up camp and spends days glassing mountains and canyons for these elusive, wary desert whitetails. Meanwhile, his hunting partner, Remi Warren, attempts the difficult task of stalking one with a bow. To cap off the hunt, Steve cooks a batch of venison ribs braised in a Dutch oven buried beneath hot coals.

programme.title: MeatEater - Clash of the Titans: Northern California Pig & Deer
programme.desc: In this episode, Steven Rinella joins forces with fellow hunter and wild game chef Hank Shaw in the hills of Central California to go after Columbia blacktail deer, wild pigs, and a handful of small game species that are in season. The end result is a culinary smorgasbord of epic proportions.

programme.title: MeatEater - Sea Bear: Alaska Spring Bear and Seafood
programme.desc: Steve ventures out to his hunting and fishing shack on a remote coastline of southeast Alaska's Prince of Wales Island. While hunting bears from a skiff and a canoe, Steve gathers a variety of prime seafood and makes a discovery about his own motivations as a bear hunter.

programme.title: MeatEater - Full Boar: Whole Hog Cooking Special
programme.desc: Steven Rinella breaks down an entire boar and shares some of his favorite recipes in this Cooking Special. Matt Weingarter helps steve make head cheese, pork skin cracklins, smoked pork butt, and a tied-roast boned-out ham. Each dish requires thoughtful butchering, processing, and cooking to execute to perfection.

programme.title: MeatEater - Southeast Alaska Blacktail Deer

programme.title: MeatEater - Nebraska Whitetails

programme.title: MeatEater - Louisiana Ducks
programme.desc: Steven Rinella joins Jean-Paul Bourgeois and Ronnie Collins in Louisiana‚ Mississippi Delta for a duck hunt. Surrounded by the unique landscape of the Delta, they target multiple duck species. After a successful hunt, the team returns to camp, where Jean-Paul prepares a traditional Cajun meal featuring the day‚ catch. Experience the cultural tradition of turning fresh game into flavorful, local dishes like duck gumbo and crawfish boil.

programme.title: MeatEater - New Mexico Turkey

programme.title: My Friend Ben
programme.desc: Finding Samantha struggling to repair a lamp, Aunt Clara uses her uncertain powers of magic to summon an electrician. Benjamin Franklin, in l8th century clothes, appears. Samantha is upset by Ben's presence and Aunt Clara's wail that she can't remember how to undo the spell. Darrin, astonished by Ben's appearance in his home, can't convince Larry Tate that Ben is not is creation for an advertising campaign for Franklin Elec-tronics. Abner Kravitz refuses to believe Gladys' report that the real Ben Franklin is at the Stephens'. Bowing to Samantha's pleas, Darrin agrees to allow her and Aunt Clara to show Ben how his inventions are being used is the city. The next morning Ben, leaving a note that he has decided to tour the city alone to avoid causing domestic discord, sets out. Darrin, Samantha and Aunt Clara start searching for him. At a firehouse, inspecting an old fire engine, Ben steps on the accelerator. The engine shoots out into the street and slams into a curb. Ben is arrested and taken to court, where the judge, sure it is all a publicity stunt, charges him with grand larceny and sets bail at a thousand dollars. Darrin puts up the bail, knowing he will lose it if Ben doesn't appear for trial is a month. Just then, Aunt Clara remembers the spell and Ben vanishes.

programme.desc: Lisa worries about Drobny the duck when the water fowl stops eating and sleeping and suffers headaches. Eb suggests the duck needs a duck girlfriend. Lisa agrees and goes about town trying to the right partner for Drobny.

programme.title: The Carpenter's Ball
programme.desc: Oliver refuses to take Lisa to the annual Carpenter's Ball because he thinks the attendees are too eccentric for his liking. But Lisa has her own motives to attend. She is trying to get a romance sparked between two local singles.

programme.title: Lisa, The Psychologist
programme.desc: When Oliver decides to attend night school and enrolls in a farming class, Lisa does the same, taking psychology. Before long, many of the residents of Hooterville are lining up for appointments with the eminent Dr. Lisa.

programme.title: Hawaiian Honeymoon
programme.desc: Aloha! The Douglases vacation in Hawaii. But the daughter of the hotel manager needs to keep secret that she double booked the honeymoon suite. The "sweet" surprise? While Lisa and Oliver settle in, they are unaware that the other room is occupied.

programme.title: The Ex-Secretary
programme.desc: Oliver's heirloom watch is broken so he tries to find his ex-secretary Carol's address to ask her the name of the jeweler who fixed it last time. Carol is now working and living in Los Angeles, and we get a glimpse into her new life.

programme.title: Oliver Buys A Farm
programme.desc: In this classic series' premiere episode, New York City attorney Oliver Wendell Douglas (Eddie Albert) satisfies his desire for the simple life by buying a farm, much to the chagrin of his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor). John Charles Daly narrates the tale!

programme.title: Lisa's First Day On The Farm
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) brings his wife, Lisa (Eva Gabor), to their new home, a ramshackle farm near Hooterville, just outside of Pixley, where she gets to meet the town's oddball residents. Bea Benaderet, Edgar Buchanan and Frank Cady guest star!

programme.title: The Decorator
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) is ready to get farming, but Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts her foot down and says she will leave unless they can hire a decorator to fix the house! Meanwhile, Kate Bradley (Bea Benaderet) teaches Lisa how to make "hotscakes."

programme.title: The Best Laid Plans
programme.desc: Is the Honeymoon period over already? The rumor mill has it that Lisa (Eva Gabor) has packed up and left Oliver (Eddie Albert). Actually, she went back to New York to close up their penthouse apartment. And Mr. Haney is up to his old tricks!

programme.title: My Husband The Rooster Renter
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) calls in a roofer, a plumber and agricultural expert Hank Kimball (Alvy Moore). All of them give the same appraisal of his farm: it's a disaster! Meanwhile, Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) has a few chickens he'd like to rent out!

programme.title: Furniture, Who's Got The Furniture?
programme.desc: The Douglases are awaiting the arrival of their furniture and they don't know it, but Oliver's mother is on her way, too. But when the furniture is accidentally delivered to Mr. Haney's new place, he tries to sell their own possession back to them.

programme.title: Neighborliness
programme.desc: Planting season ends in three weeks and Oliver has yet to get his land plowed. Meanwhile, Uncle Joe (Edgar Buchanan) needs a new shotgun before duck hunting season starts and schemes to solve both of their problems...without Oliver knowing it.

programme.title: Lisa, The Helpmate
programme.desc: When Oliver (Eddie Albert) sends a sample of his soil to the State Scientific College, a report comes back that his farm contains ingredients never before found in soil. Could his soil problems just be cosmetic? Eleanor Audley guest stars.

programme.title: You Can't Plug In A 2 With A 6
programme.desc: Relying on statistics provided by the Department of Agriculture, Oliver (Eddie Albert) decides to plant wheat. But when he goes to Drucker's to buy seed, he learns the other farmers have a unique way to predict the best crop�Mrs. Ziffel's lumbago.

programme.title: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
programme.desc: After some wheeling and dealing and mending a riff between Mr. Kimball and his mother, Oliver (Eddie Albert) finally has a phone installed, but the Hooterville Phone Company installs it directly outside his bedroom window...on top of the phone pole.

programme.title: Parity Begins At Home
programme.desc: Oliver (Eddie Albert) plants his entire 160 acres with wheat, only to hear from The Crabwell Corners Conservation and Stabilization Committee, a local farm organization, that he was only permitted to grow eight acres of wheat�because of Mr. Haney.

programme.title: Lisa Has A Calf
programme.desc: The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

programme.title: Ophelia Visits Morticia
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Addams Cum Laude
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: Cat Addams
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: Lurch's Little Helper
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Policy
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: Lurch's Grand Romance
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: Ophelia's Career
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: Morticia And The Psychiatrist
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: Fester's Punctured Romance
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: Gomez, The Politician
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family Tree
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: Morticia Joins The Ladies League
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In KENYA!

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Day In China!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed begins his journey through China, stepping into one of the world’s most fascinating and fast-paced countries for the very first time. From navigating bustling city streets and trying new foods to experiencing the culture and meeting locals, Speed takes in the sights, sounds, and energy of China with his signature curiosity and chaos. The episode captures the excitement, surprises, and unforgettable first impressions that kick off his adventure across the country.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Discovers Mongolian Throat Singing
programme.desc: IShowSpeed experiences the ancient art of Mongolian throat singing, immersing himself in one of the country's most unique and celebrated cultural traditions. Guided by talented local performers, Speed learns how singers produce multiple tones at once while discovering the history and significance of this centuries-old musical practice. From hilarious attempts to master the technique to unforgettable performances, the episode blends cultural discovery, entertainment, and Speed's signature energy, offering a rare look into one of Mongolia's most extraordinary artistic traditions.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Chongqing, China!

From exploring the city’s famous landmarks and local culture to navigating its bustling streets and unforgettable atmosphere, the episode captures an unfiltered adventure through one of China’s most dynamic urban destinations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Jamaica!

Blending adventure, entertainment, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through the heart of Jamaican culture.
